I happened to be close with a FinSec officer.|Counselor [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]] questions Lieutenant [[Lydea Pagorski]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
'''Bloodfin Security''', commonly abbreviated as '''FinSec''', was the designation for the forces responsible for security operations aboard the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']].

In [[41 ABY]], the ''Bloodfin'' was engaged during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] refused to comply with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]' orders to ignore the ceasefire and attack [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], [[Tahiri Veila]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] him with the support of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]], including [[Quille]] and [[Rosset]]. The assassination instigated a mutiny aboard the ''Bloodfin'' among the crew, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and other security forces. The ''Bloodfin'' was then boarded by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Protectors]], which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many of the ship's crew including its security forces.
